description: Equipment asset inventory and readable fallback (REQ-029; C56; R122, R132; AC-C56-01, AC-R029-01, AC-R029-02; JOURNEY-029). The verified inventory is stated in source by src/ui/refinements/equipment-assets.ts and recorded in docs/design/library/refinements-2026-11-04/authority/EQUIPMENT-ICON-WANTED-LIST.md: the 75 shipped icons of src/design-system/assets/icons.tsx unchanged (pinned to the accepted reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d), Dumbbell and WeightPlate the only equipment glyphs, the approved round Frown/Meh/Smile/SmilePlus exception with Effort still reusing Frown, Meh and Smile, Setup's 16 equipment ids unchanged and no medicine-ball setup id. On the real /review and /workout routes (existing Review hand-off and auth guard) one composition naming every Setup id and the Wall ball's medicine ball shows each equipment as the readable label beside its movement name, never a glyph alone, and Review's Required equipment names each kind in words; Setup (/onboarding, through the onboarding guard) names its sixteen choices in words. A failed Start keeps every label. JOURNEY-029 is read in each skin (clear, vapour, signal, mono): on /review and /workout every equipment label paints the skin's own --text-secondary and measures at WCAG AA text contrast (4.5:1) against its captured ground, with the axe scan run per skin, and Setup's sixteen worded choices are read and scanned per skin. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=assets draws the shared inventory and the routes' own Review, Workout and Setup equipment. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-029 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/movement-identity.test.tsx --testNamePattern equipment --passWithNoTests=false
